title: Feedback, status & numbers
summary: Counters, progress, loading and messages that stay readable and never shift the layout.

components.name: Count-up number
components.summary: A KPI that counts up once when it scrolls into view, with width reserved so nothing moves.
called: number that counts up when you scroll to it

anatomy.name: Value
anatomy.text: Width is reserved for the final number, so nothing shifts while it counts.

anatomy.name: Label
anatomy.text: Says what is being counted.

components.prompt: Add a count-up KPI: a <data value> element that counts from 0 to its value once when it enters the viewport (ease-out exponential, about 1.1s), formatted with Intl.NumberFormat, tabular numbers, a min-width for the final value, and an aria-label with the final value. Skip the animation under reduced motion.
components.debug: Debug my count-up. Rule out: the number re-animating on every scroll; width jumping as digits change (tabular-nums and min-width); screen readers hearing every frame (set aria-label to the final value). The symptom:

components.name: Rolling odometer
components.summary: Digits roll vertically to the new value like a mechanical counter.
called: rolling numbers like a slot machine
digits that scroll to the new number

anatomy.name: Digit window
anatomy.text: Shows one row of a 0–9 strip.

anatomy.name: Strip
anatomy.text: Rolls to the new digit.

anatomy.name: Separator
anatomy.text: Commas stay put.

components.prompt: Add a rolling odometer: each digit is a 0–9 vertical strip inside a one-digit window, translated to the digit; separators stay still; rebuild only when the digit count changes; give the wrapper role="img" with the value as its label.
components.debug: Debug my odometer. Rule out: strips rebuilt on every update (so nothing rolls); the window height not matching line-height; proportional figures misaligning columns. The symptom:

components.name: Split-flap flip clock
components.summary: A countdown whose digits flip like a departures board.
called: flip clock like an airport departures board

anatomy.name: Flap card
anatomy.text: Top half falls, the new bottom half rises.

anatomy.name: Unit label
anatomy.text: Hours, minutes, seconds.

anatomy.name: Timer
anatomy.text: Screen readers get a once-a-minute summary, not every second.

components.prompt: Add a split-flap countdown: each digit is a card of four halves (top, bottom, falling flap, rising flap) animated with rotateX and backface-visibility, role="timer" on the group, and a visually hidden summary updated once a minute.
components.debug: Debug my flip clock. Rule out: flaps showing the old digit after flipping; perspective set on the wrong element; announcements every second; flips running under reduced motion. The symptom:

components.name: Live status dot
components.summary: Small coloured dots with an optional pulse for live states, always paired with text.
called: green dot that pulses for online

anatomy.name: Live dot
anatomy.text: A soft pulse for things happening now.

anatomy.name: Status text
anatomy.text: Always paired: colour alone never carries meaning.

components.prompt: Add status dots: 8px circles in status colours, an optional pulse ring (::after scaling out and fading) for live states, always next to a text label, with the pulse removed under reduced motion.
components.debug: Debug my status dot. Rule out: colour as the only signal; the pulse running under reduced motion; dots that do not meet 3:1 against their background. The symptom:

components.name: Progress bar
components.summary: Determinate and indeterminate bars with a label and tabular value.

anatomy.name: Fill
anatomy.text: Width follows the value.

anatomy.name: Indeterminate
anatomy.text: A sliding segment when the total is unknown.

components.prompt: Add progress bars: role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow/min/max and a visible label; indeterminate bars omit aria-valuenow and slide a segment back and forth.
components.debug: Debug my progress bar. Rule out: aria-valuenow on an indeterminate bar; width transitions that lag behind fast updates; the label missing. The symptom:

components.name: Circular progress ring
components.summary: A ring that fills to a value, with the number in the middle.
called: radial progress with a number in the middle

anatomy.name: Arc
anatomy.text: stroke-dashoffset = 100 − value.

anatomy.name: Centre value
anatomy.text: The number, large.

components.prompt: Add a progress ring: an SVG circle with pathLength="100", stroke-dasharray 100 and stroke-dashoffset 100 − value, rotated −90° to start at the top, with the value centred and role="progressbar".
components.debug: Debug my progress ring. Rule out: the arc starting at 3 o'clock (rotate −90°); stroke clipped at the edges (radius minus half the stroke); no accessible value. The symptom:

components.name: Multi-segment meter
components.summary: One bar split into labelled segments, like a storage breakdown.

anatomy.name: Segments
anatomy.text: One bar, one colour per part.

anatomy.name: Legend
anatomy.text: Each part with its value, so colour is not the only key.

components.prompt: Add a multi-segment meter: one rounded bar split into coloured segments by share, a legend with values in tabular numbers, and role="img" with a full text summary.
components.debug: Debug my meter. Rule out: segments with no gap blending together; a legend without values; segment colours under 3:1 against the track. The symptom:

components.name: Shimmer skeleton
components.summary: Soft grey shapes in the layout of the content, with a subtle shimmer while it loads.

anatomy.name: Avatar block
anatomy.text: Matches the real avatar size.

anatomy.name: Media block
anatomy.text: Same aspect ratio as what will load.

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.text: Tells assistive tech the region is loading.

components.prompt: Add skeleton placeholders that match the real layout (same sizes and aspect ratios), a subtle shimmer gradient that stops under reduced motion, and aria-busy="true" with a label on the container.
components.debug: Debug my skeleton. Rule out: skeletons of a different size from the content (layout jumps on load); shimmer under reduced motion; skeletons shown for under 300ms (flash). The symptom:

components.name: Pull to refresh
components.summary: Pull a list down past a mark and let go to reload it; a Refresh button does the same without the gesture.
called: pull down the list to load new items
the spinner when you drag a feed down

anatomy.name: Indicator
anatomy.text: Fills as the list is pulled and turns once it is past the mark.

anatomy.name: Stamp
anatomy.text: When the list was last updated, in words.

anatomy.name: Refresh button
anatomy.text: The same refresh for keyboard, mouse and switch users.

components.prompt: Add pull to refresh: only when the list is scrolled to the top, a downward drag moves the content with resistance (half the finger distance, capped) and fills a small ring above it; past 64px the ring is armed and letting go starts a refresh: content stays down by about 52px with the ring spinning until the data arrives, then settles back and the "Updated" stamp changes. Use touch events with a non-passive touchmove that only prevents default while pulling, and pointer events for a mouse. Fire a cancelable lt-refresh event with a done() callback. Always offer a visible Refresh button and announce "Refreshing" and the result in a status region. No spin under reduced motion.
components.debug: Debug my pull to refresh. Rule out: the pull starting when the list is not at the top; page scrolling fighting the pull (preventDefault only while pulling, on a non-passive listener); a tap on a row firing after a pull; no way to refresh without the gesture; the spinner never stopping because done() is never called. The symptom:

components.name: Empty state
components.summary: A calm block that explains why a list is empty and offers one clear action.
called: blank page with a button to start

anatomy.name: Icon
anatomy.text: Quiet and related to the content.

anatomy.name: Headline
anatomy.text: Says what is missing, plainly.

anatomy.name: Next step
anatomy.text: One primary action, one quiet alternative.

components.prompt: Add an empty state: a muted icon, a plain headline saying what is missing ("No reports yet"), one sentence on how it fills up, one primary action and one secondary.
components.debug: Debug my empty state. Rule out: clever copy that does not say what to do; two primary buttons; empty states shown while data is still loading. The symptom:

components.name: Toast stack
components.summary: Stacked notifications that expand on hover, pause while read and swipe away.
called: little notification that pops up in the corner

anatomy.name: Toast
anatomy.text: Errors use alert; everything else is polite.

anatomy.name: Dismiss
anatomy.text: Also swipe sideways or press Esc.

anatomy.name: Stack
anatomy.text: Newest in front; the stack fans out on hover and pauses its timers.

components.prompt: Add a toast stack: a fixed region bottom-right, newest toast in front with older ones tucked behind, expand on hover or focus, pause timers while hovered, swipe or Esc to dismiss, role="status" for info and role="alert" for errors.
components.debug: Debug my toasts. Rule out: toasts disappearing while being read (pause on hover/focus); focus moved into the toast; every toast as role="alert"; the stack covering primary buttons on mobile. The symptom:

components.name: Callout
components.summary: Inline info, tip, warning and danger notes inside content.

anatomy.name: Icon
anatomy.text: Shape and colour both signal the tone.

anatomy.name: Title
anatomy.text: Two or three words.

components.prompt: Add callouts: <aside> blocks with an icon, a short bold title and body text on the matching status-soft background, in four tones (info, tip, warning, danger).
components.debug: Debug my callouts. Rule out: body text on tinted backgrounds under 4.5:1; colour as the only difference between tones; callouts used for every paragraph. The symptom:

components.name: Announcement banner
components.summary: A thin, dismissible page-top strip for one announcement.
called: thin announcement bar at the top
new feature strip with a link

anatomy.name: Label
anatomy.text: One badge, at most.

anatomy.name: Link
anatomy.text: Says where it goes.

anatomy.name: Dismiss
anatomy.text: Remembered once closed.

components.prompt: Add an announcement banner: one line with a badge, a short message and a link, a dismiss button with an aria-label, and dismissal remembered in localStorage.
components.debug: Debug my banner. Rule out: banners that come back on every page; the close button without a name; the banner pushing content down after load (reserve its height). The symptom:

components.name: Badge system
components.summary: Neutral, accent and status pills, with dot, outline and count variants.
called: new tag next to a heading

anatomy.name: Accent badge
anatomy.text: At most two accent or status badges in view.

anatomy.name: Dot badge
anatomy.text: A dot plus text for states.

anatomy.name: Count
anatomy.text: "12 unread", not just 12.

components.prompt: Add badges: small pills in neutral, accent and status tones with optional dot, outline and count variants. One badge per heading, two accent badges in view at most.
components.debug: Debug my badges. Rule out: five badges in one header; tinted text under 4.5:1; counts without spoken labels. The symptom:

components.name: Keyboard key cap
components.summary: Crisp key caps for shortcuts and key sequences.
called: little key caps in a menu

anatomy.name: Key cap
anatomy.text: A slightly deeper bottom border makes it read as a key.

components.prompt: Add keyboard shortcut caps with <kbd>: mono, small, a 2px bottom border, one element per key, and "then" between sequential keys.
components.debug: Debug my key caps. Rule out: ⌘ shown to Windows users (show Ctrl); combinations written as one <kbd>; caps that wrap. The symptom:

components.name: Loaders
components.summary: Spinner, three dots and an indeterminate bar for short waits, plus a busy button.

anatomy.name: Spinner
anatomy.text: One accent arc on a faint ring.

anatomy.name: Bar
anatomy.text: For page-level waits under a header.

anatomy.name: Busy button
anatomy.text: Keeps its width; the label says what is happening.

components.prompt: Add loaders for short waits: a 22px spinner (faint ring, accent top arc), three pulsing dots, a 3px indeterminate bar, and a busy button with a small spinner and "Saving". All use role="status" or progressbar with a label, and slow down or stop under reduced motion. Use skeletons instead when the layout is known.
components.debug: Debug my loader. Rule out: a spinner with no accessible name; spinners shown for waits under 300ms (flicker); loaders that shift layout when they appear; full-screen spinners where a skeleton would do. The symptom:

components.name: Setup checklist
components.summary: Onboarding steps with round checkboxes, a progress ring and a running count.
called: todo card with a circle that fills

anatomy.name: Progress ring
anatomy.text: Fills as steps are ticked; green means done.

anatomy.name: Done step
anatomy.text: Filled tick and a quiet strike-through.

anatomy.name: Count
anatomy.text: "2 of 5 done", then a short line when finished.

components.prompt: Add a setup checklist card: a title with a live "2 of 5 done" count and a small progress ring, then 3–6 steps each with a round role="checkbox" tick, a title and one line of help. Done steps get a filled green tick and a quiet strike-through; the count changes to a short sentence when everything is done.
components.debug: Debug my checklist. Rule out: ticks that are divs with no keyboard path; progress shown only by the ring; steps that cannot be unticked; celebrating with confetti instead of a quiet line. The symptom:

components.name: Undo snackbar
components.summary: Delete at once and offer Undo for a few seconds, instead of asking "Are you sure?".
called: message at the bottom with an undo button
snackbar that lets you take it back

anatomy.name: What happened
anatomy.text: Names the thing, in the past tense.

anatomy.name: Undo
anatomy.text: One action; restores focus to the row.

anatomy.name: Time left
anatomy.text: A thin line shows how long Undo stays.

components.prompt: Replace confirm dialogs for reversible deletes with an undo snackbar: remove the item immediately, show a dark status bar ("Deleted “Q4 forecast”." + Undo) with a thin countdown line, pause the timer while hovered or focused, commit after six seconds, and restore the row and focus on Undo.
components.debug: Debug my undo snackbar. Rule out: deleting on the server before the timer ends; a timer that keeps running while the user reaches for Undo; focus lost after Undo; using it for actions that cannot be undone. The symptom:

components.name: Announcement pill
components.summary: One short line in a pill above a headline: a tagged link to what is new, a two-part fact, or a live status.
called: the little pill above the headline
rounded announcement link in the hero

anatomy.name: Tag
anatomy.text: One word: New, Beta, v4.

anatomy.name: Lead
anatomy.text: The fact in primary ink; the rest stays secondary.

anatomy.name: Arrow
anatomy.text: Only when the pill is a link.

components.prompt: Add an announcement pill above the hero headline: a fully rounded hairline pill on a surface fill, 14px text in secondary ink. Variant one is a link with a one-word accent tag ("New"), a short line and a small arrow that nudges 2px on hover. Variant two is a two-part fact with the first part bold in primary ink. Variant three is a status with a 7px green dot. One pill per hero, under 60 characters.
components.debug: Debug my announcement pill. Rule out: two pills in one hero; a sentence that wraps to two lines; a pill that looks clickable but is not a link; emoji as the tag; the pill competing with the primary button for colour. The symptom:
